name: Merrin Coil
source_profile:
Merrin Coil (CN) — Proprietor of the Last Water

Merrin is a sharp-tongued widow who has operated a public house in Redvale since before the town's recent expansion. She knows most of the settlement's older families and has an extraordinary talent for remembering names, faces, and unpaid debts.

Although Merrin makes her living selling drink and hosting gamblers, she maintains several firm rules: no drawing weapons indoors, no cheating the house, and no mistreating her employees. She is a remarkably useful source of local gossip, though she generally expects something in return.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 102 (source excerpt; may be partial)
